# Make Fun

Creating unforgettable play experiences for over 30 years

[ View all products ][149] [ Bespoke services ][150]

At Airquee, we’re *serious about fun, *designing and manufacturing inflatables and play attractions
for all ages. From giant inflatable parks to soft play and fibreglass structures, our UK base and
European hubs support projects of every size, delivering *imaginative experiences* that put fun
first.

100% 5 star reviews on [Google][151]
* Manufactured in-house from design to delivery
* European-wide production, logistics, and support

Common questions
* [ Can I put my logo on products? ][173]
  
  Yes. We can add your logo, branding, colours or bespoke artwork to many products for a small
  additional cost.
* [ What finance options are available? ][174]
  
  We work with trusted finance partners to offer flexible payment options, subject to approval.
  
  We also accept Klarna, Shop Pay Instalments and PayPal Pay in 3 at checkout.
* [ Can you help with repairs? ][175]
  
  Yes. Our repair and service teams can help with repairs, maintenance, testing and aftercare.
* [ Where can I come and see you? ][176]
  
  You can visit us at our Leicester sales office, Cwmbran warehouse/service centre, or at shows and
  open days throughout the year.
* [ What’s best for my business? ][177]
  
  Speak to our team and we’ll help you choose the right products for your space, budget, customers
  and business goals.

## Where Big Fun Meets Big Experience

With over 30 years of commercial inflatable manufacturing excellence, Airquee has built a global
reputation for quality, innovation, and reliability. Airquee designs, manufactures, and supplies
thousands of inflatables each year, delivering projects that range from off-the-shelf products to
complex bespoke installations.

Airquee has installed more than 150 inflatable parks across 30+ countries and operates in full
compliance with European safety standards. Our proven expertise spans leisure, education,
healthcare, military, and corporate sectors, making Airquee your trusted partner worldwide.

Common questions
* [ Can I put my logo on products? ][173]
  
  Yes. We can add your logo, branding, colours or bespoke artwork to many products for a small
  additional cost.
* [ What finance options are available? ][174]
  
  We work with trusted finance partners to offer flexible payment options, subject to approval.

* [ Can you help with repairs? ][175]
  
  Yes. Our repair and service teams can help with repairs, maintenance, testing and aftercare.

  open days throughout the year.

## Where Big Fun Meets Big Experience

With over 30 years of commercial inflatable manufacturing excellence, Airquee has built a global
reputation for quality, innovation, and reliability. Airquee designs, manufactures, and supplies
thousands of inflatables each year, delivering projects that range from off-the-shelf products to
complex bespoke installations.

Airquee has installed more than 150 inflatable parks across 30+ countries and operates in full
compliance with European safety standards. Our proven expertise spans leisure, education,
healthcare, military, and corporate sectors, making Airquee your trusted partner worldwide.
